description:
Outcome: Email sign-in, permissions and coordinator recovery; source: conversation sign-in decision; brief.md Constraints.
Scope: Passwordless emailed one-time links, sessions/sign-out, household accounts, coordinator-only actions and secure out-of-band first coordinator bootstrap/mailbox recovery.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in T-018.
Acceptance: Links expire, single-use, safe redirect validation and server permissions; no public role assignment. Gardener sees own account as needed and own allocation; stored contact listings, report lists/details/history and reconciliation are coordinator-only.
Behaviour: Generic sign-in response, rate limiting, resend/expired-link recovery and accessible feedback; administrator recovery action recorded.
Verification: Expiry/reuse, enumeration, cross-household/direct-ID and role escalation tests; bootstrap/recovery demonstration; privacy after household merge and plot reassignment.
Prerequisites: T-001, T-004.
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator configures local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, advisory preferences and application order within groups; FIFO waiting list; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique, history preserved; own active-plot reporting with coordinator-only report access; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local and skips empty days. No existing implementation. T-003 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: Email sign-in, permissions and coordinator recovery
